summary: Havenhythe catalog areas are mostly wiki-correct place names and anchors cover all eight. The hard collisions are name-role reuse: Moonrise Dig Site is simultaneously an area, a content row, and an upgrade row; Apex Hide Armour and Havenhythe Big Game Hunter each appear as both content and upgrade (Apex content even uses kind "upgrade"). Soft duplicates also pair Birdhouses / fish farming content with renamed upgrade rows, and Black chinchompas content with Volatile chinchompas upgrade for the same Highweald catch. Marigold Farm is a full wiki place (allotment hub) and already has an upgrade row, but is absent from areas while Eastfold Farm (sheep farm) is present — those are not the same farm. Cross-region pollution: Fairy ring network and Ungael ritual site pressure sit on regionId havenhythe. League Area Tasks page is still a sparse stub; do not invent Equilibrium task or blessing numbers. applyReady is false until renames and the Marigold area decision are applied intentionally.

issues.name: Moonrise Dig Site
issues.detail: Exact same display string in areas[], content[] (kind Archaeology), and upgrades[] (category Archaeology dig-site hub). Map place, activity, and unlock package cannot share one name without UI/identity collisions.

issues.name: Apex Hide Armour
issues.detail: Identical name in content and upgrades. Content row has kind "upgrade" (wrong bucket for a content list). Upgrade row is the correct home for the t85 Ranged set; content should either drop or become the BGH materials activity path under a different name.

issues.name: Havenhythe Big Game Hunter
issues.detail: Activity name appears in both content (kind Hunter) and upgrades (category Hunter apex encounters). Wiki: activity inside Hollow Hill cave, 96 Hunter / 77 Slayer floor, apex hide + meat drops. Keep activity name on content; rename upgrade to progression/materials framing.

issues.name: Marigold Farm
issues.detail: Wiki Areas TOC lists Marigold Farm separately from Eastfold Farm. Marigold = allotment/herb/flower; Eastfold = sheep. Catalog has upgrade "Marigold Farm patch cluster" but no area; map therefore cannot pin Marigold. Adding it requires a placeAnchors UV (tests enforce catalog areas ↔ anchors).

Same real activity: box-trap Volatile chinchompas in Highweald; catches become Black chinchompa weapons. Content says Black chinchompas (item); upgrade says Volatile chinchompas (creature). Align naming to avoid double-counting in planners.
Already partially disambiguated by upgrade prefix. Content generic "Birdhouses" is OK as activity; upgrade is the regional infrastructure row. Optional tighten only.
Same Wendlewick multi-pool farm. Soft name drift only.
Both content rows use kind "upgrade". Content list should not re-host upgrade objects; Masterwork materials has no matching upgrades[] row either (only mentioned in Apex upgrade detail).
Both upgrades have regionId havenhythe but are multi-region / primarily Misthalin–Morytania (fairy rings) or Fremennik (Ungael). Should not live as Havenhythe-primary rows; Kayazu remains Havenhythe.
All 8 current catalog areas have PLACE_ANCHORS entries. No orphan anchors. Adding Marigold Farm is the only planned anchor change.

Equilibrium League/Areas/Havenhythe wiki page lists settlements (Wendlewick, Amberfell), bosses (Ivar, Silverquill), and non-combat (BGH, fish farm, Shrine, birdhouses) but unlocks/tasks tables are empty stubs. No invented task points, auto-quests, or blessing values in this audit.
